source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 258 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 258 was established by Ordinance No. 19379, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 19, 1986. Ordinance No. 19379 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 258 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Ravenview Road and Beauford Road. The size of PD 258 is approximately 38.27 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Site Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.104. SITE PLAN.

A site plan showing the separate tracts within this PD is labelled Exhibit 258A. No additional site plan approval is required for uses that are allowed by right in the PD. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.105. PERMITTED USES.

The only permitted uses on the Property are those uses allowed in an R-7.5 Single-Family District. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.106. LANDSCAPING.

All nonresidential development on the Property must comply with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.107. HEIGHT.

No structure may exceed the height requirements of an R-7.5 Single-Family District, as set forth in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.108. MINIMUM SETBACKS.

All front, side, and rear yard setbacks must meet the requirements of an R-7.5 Single-Family District, as contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Lot Width
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.109. MINIMUM LOT WIDTH.

(a) Generally. Minimum lot width requirement is 55 feet.

(b) Exceptions.

(1) If a lot is shown as being divided by a dashed line on the site plan, the minimum lot width requirement is the width shown on site plan between the lot line and the dashed line.

(2) If two tracts are joined by a “Z” designation on Exhibit 258A, the minimum lot width for the tracts as joined is 55 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Lot Depth
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.110. MINIMUM LOT DEPTH.

Minimum lot depth requirement is 100 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Minimum Lot Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.111. MINIMUM LOT AREA.

(a) Generally. Minimum lot area is 7,500 square feet.

(b) Exception. If a lot is shown as being divided by a dashed line on Exhibit 258A, minimum lot area is the area delineated by the dashed line and the lot line. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking for each use must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.113. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the requirements for a non-business zoning district as contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.114. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-258.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 258 is located on Zoning Map Nos. N-12 and O-12. (Ord. Nos. 19379; 25711)
